Standalone DOCX extraction using extract

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(filename: 'fake.docx', kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', uri: 'https://example.com/docx/fake.docx'))
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
